- Amount mismatch → 409
- Other conditions → 4xx
- Idempotency handling via ActionRequest with operation="countersign.v6"

- Same key+different purchase = 409
- Different actor with same key = no conflict
- Requester call = 403, unauthenticated = 401
- After countersign: cannot be bulk-approved, bulk-rejected, or countersigned again
- Operation name: "countersign.v6" (based on existing pattern)
- Need Separate=true to ensure different approver from the one who pushed to pending-second
